privacy.seoDescription: What Studafy collects, why, and how to request your data or its deletion.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Studafy is provided to schools, who set up accounts for their students, families, and staff. This page explains what the Studafy web and mobile apps collect from those accounts, why, and how to request a copy of your data or its deletion.
privacy.accountsBody: Studafy accounts are created by your school, not by signing up directly. Signing in uses your school-configured identity provider (Microsoft or Google) — Studafy does not see or store your password.
privacy.collectIntro: Everything below is collected either by Studafy’s own servers, or by our crash and performance diagnostics vendors (Firebase and Sentry) acting on our behalf. We do not use any advertising or analytics network, and we do not sell or share your data with anyone for their own purposes.
privacy.collectEducation: Education records. Timetable, grades, attendance, assignments, course materials, and — for a teacher’s own classes — discipline incident reports.
privacy.collectIdentifiers: Account identifiers. An internal account id and, if you enable push notifications, a device push token, so notifications and crash reports can be tied to your account.
privacy.collectDiagnostics: Crash and performance diagnostics. If the app crashes or performs poorly, technical details (device type, OS version, a stack trace) are sent to our crash-reporting vendors, identified only by your internal account id — never your name or email.
privacy.collectContent: Content you or your school upload. Photos taken for teaching materials, uploaded documents, and assignment submissions.
privacy.collectBilling: Billing history (parents/guardians only), if your school bills you through Studafy: invoice amounts and payment status. Card details are entered on our payment processor’s own page, never stored by Studafy.
privacy.collectAi: Questions to the AI study tools (students), only after you agree to the in-app notice: your question and the related study material are sent to our AI provider, Anthropic, which processes them on our behalf to answer you.
privacy.collectContact: Your name and email address come from your school, which sets up your account, and from your identity provider when you sign in. We use your email address to recognise your account at sign-in and to send account messages, such as a deletion confirmation. We do not collect your phone number.
privacy.rightsIntro: You can request a copy of your data, or request that it be deleted, at any time:
privacy.rightsSignedOut: Without signing in or installing the app, request deletion on the <deleteLink>delete your account</deleteLink> page: we email a link to the account’s address, and the deletion happens once you confirm it.
privacy.rightsCopy: For a copy of your data, contact your school, or email us — see Contact below.
privacy.rightsDeletion: Deleting your account signs you out everywhere, removes you from your school and stops any AI subscription from renewing immediately; erasing your personal data follows within 30 days. Your school keeps only records it is legally required to retain — grades and attendance without your name or contact details, financial records, and its audit log — and the confirmation screen and confirmation email list them, so nothing is silently kept back.
privacy.contactBody: Questions about this policy or your data: <mailLink>{{email}}</mailLink>.

deleteAccount.seoDescription: How to request deletion of your Studafy account and data.
deleteAccount.title: Delete your account
deleteAccount.intro: You can delete your Studafy account and its data at any time, with or without the app. Personal data is erased within 30 days; see the <privacyLink>privacy policy</privacyLink> for the records the law requires your school to keep.
deleteAccount.signedInBody: Go to <deleteLink>Account settings › Delete account</deleteLink> in the Studafy web app (or the equivalent screen in the mobile app) and confirm. It takes effect immediately — no one else needs to act on it.
deleteAccount.signedOutBody: Enter the email address your school uses for your account. If it has a Studafy account, we will email it a link to confirm the deletion. The link works once, for one hour.
deleteAccount.noMailbox: No longer have access to that mailbox? Contact your school.
deleteAccount.noMailboxWithEmail: No longer have access to that mailbox? Contact your school, or email us at <mailLink>{{email}}</mailLink>.
deleteAccount.whatHappensBody: Straight away, you are signed out on every device, your account is removed from your school, and any AI subscription is cancelled so it does not renew. Within 30 days, your name, contact details and profile are erased. We email you a confirmation.
deleteAccount.retainedBody: Your school keeps only the records it is legally required to: your grades and attendance (without your name or contact details), financial records, and its audit log. The confirmation screen lists these — see the <privacyLink>privacy policy</privacyLink> for detail.
deleteAccount.sent: If {{email}} has a Studafy account, we have sent it a link to confirm the deletion. Check your inbox and spam folder; the link expires in one hour.
deleteAccount.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
deleteAccount.captchaExpired: The challenge expired. Please complete it again.

confirmDeletion.seoDescription: Confirm deletion of your Studafy account.
confirmDeletion.title: Delete your account
confirmDeletion.body: This deletes the Studafy account registered to your email address, in every school it belongs to. Straight away, you are signed out on every device, the account is removed from the school, and any AI subscription is cancelled. Your name, contact details and profile are erased within 30 days.
confirmDeletion.linkInvalid: This link is invalid, has expired, or has already been used.
confirmDeletion.nothingBody: There is no active Studafy account for this email address any more. It may already have been deleted.
confirmDeletion.retainedIntro: We have emailed you a confirmation. Your school keeps only these records:
